attributes: history_version: u64 (bumped whenever history is rewritten, e.g. compaction or rollback)
token_info: Option<TokenUsageInfo> (last API response token usage + cumulative)
reference_context_item: Option<TurnContextItem> (baseline snapshot used for diffing and producing model-visible settings update items; None means next turn emits full reinjection of context state)

data_flows.transform: filter non-api messages and non-GhostSnapshot, then process_item (truncate function output payloads with policy * 1.2 serialization budget)
normalize_history: ensure_call_outputs_present + remove_orphan_outputs + strip_images_when_unsupported + drop GhostSnapshot
TokenUsageInfo::new_or_append with model_context_window

RESIZED_IMAGE_BYTES_ESTIMATE.note: approximate model-visible byte cost for one resized image input; 7373 bytes maps to ~1844 tokens via 4-bytes/token heuristic with ceiling division

ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATCH_SIZE.note: patch size in pixels for detail=original image token estimation

ORIGINAL_IMAGE_ESTIMATE_CACHE_SIZE.note: LRU cache size for original-image byte estimates

terms.object: TotalTokenUsageBreakdown (token usage snapshot produced by ContextManager)
attributes: last_api_response_total_tokens: i64 (total_tokens from most recent API response)
all_history_items_model_visible_bytes: i64 (sum of estimate_response_item_model_visible_bytes across every item in history)
estimated_tokens_of_items_added_since_last_successful_api_response: i64 (local items added after most recent model-generated item, not yet reflected in last_token_usage.total_tokens)
estimated_bytes_of_items_added_since_last_successful_api_response: i64 (byte-level counterpart for local items added after last model-generated item)

data_flows.transform: sum estimate_item_token_count / estimate_response_item_model_visible_bytes

terms.object: Response Item (classification of items stored in history)
attributes: role: string (for Message items: user, assistant, developer, system)

kind: variant (Message, Reasoning, FunctionCall, FunctionCallOutput, ToolSearchCall, ToolSearchOutput, CustomToolCall, CustomToolCallOutput, LocalShellCall, WebSearchCall, ImageGenerationCall, Compaction, GhostSnapshot, Other)
is_api_message: bool (true for non-system Message and all tool/reasoning/compaction kinds, false for GhostSnapshot and Other)
is_model_generated: bool (true for assistant Message, Reasoning, FunctionCall, ToolSearchCall, WebSearchCall, ImageGenerationCall, CustomToolCall, LocalShellCall, Compaction)
is_codex_generated: bool (FunctionCallOutput, ToolSearchOutput, CustomToolCallOutput, or developer Message)
is_user_turn_boundary: bool (user Message with non-contextual content, or assistant Message with InterAgentCommunication content)

terms.object: InitialContextInjection (controls whether compaction replacement history must include initial context)

InitialContextInjection: BeforeLastUserMessage (mid-turn compaction: inject initial context into replacement history just above the last real user message, because model is trained to see compaction summary as last item)
DoNotInject (pre-turn/manual compaction: replace history with summary and clear reference_context_item so next regular turn fully reinjects initial context)

terms.object: CompactionAnalyticsAttempt (analytics record for one compaction attempt)

data_flows.transform: build CodexCompactionEvent

terms.object: CompactedItem (result of one compaction: summary + replacement history)
attributes: message: string (summary text; for remote compaction this is empty, for inline it is SUMMARY_PREFIX + last assistant message or '(no summary available)')
replacement_history: Option<Vec<ResponseItem>> (full history that replaces the pre-compaction history)

data_flows.source: pre-compaction history (user messages + last assistant summary)
data_flows.transform: build_compacted_history: keep user messages truncated to COMPACT_USER_MESSAGE_MAX_TOKENS then append summary_text as user message
should_keep_compacted_history_item filter + insert_initial_context_before_last_real_user_or_summary + extend ghost_snapshots

COMPACT_USER_MESSAGE_MAX_TOKENS.note: maximum tokens of user messages preserved when building compacted history from most recent back

SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT.note: synthesized prompt text sent to model for auto-compaction

SUMMARY_PREFIX.note: prefix prepended to last assistant message to form compaction summary; is_summary_message() recognizes user messages starting with this prefix

terms.object: EnvironmentContext (turn-level environment snapshot injected as contextual user message)
attributes: shell: Shell (user shell; ignored when comparing turn-to-turn because only initial context includes it)
subagents: Option<string> (subagent description block; only set via with_subagents when non-empty)

data_flows.transform: from_turn_context
diff_from_turn_context_item: cwd diffed, current_date/timezone always from next, network diffed and only changed emitted
serialize_to_xml: emit <cwd>, <shell>, <current_date>, <timezone>, <network enabled=true> with <allowed>/<denied> children, <subagents> lines; wrap in ENVIRONMENT_CONTEXT_FRAGMENT tags

include_environment_context.note: gates whether build_environment_update_item emits any diff

data_flows.transform: extract allowed_domains()/denied_domains(), default empty vec

terms.object: Contextual User Fragment (injected user-role message containing prompt scaffolding rather than real user conversation)

CONTEXTUAL_USER_FRAGMENTS: AGENTS_MD_FRAGMENT (AGENTS.md guidance; excluded from memory stage-1 inputs because it is prompt scaffolding)
ENVIRONMENT_CONTEXT_FRAGMENT (<environment_context> ... </environment_context>; kept in memory inputs because it carries useful execution context)
SKILL_FRAGMENT (skill payload; excluded from memory stage-1 inputs)
SUBAGENT_NOTIFICATION_FRAGMENT (<subagent_notification> ... </subagent_notification>; kept in memory inputs because it carries subtask outcomes)

data_flows.transform: is_contextual_user_fragment: parse_hook_prompt_fragment OR any CONTEXTUAL_USER_FRAGMENTS.matches_text
data_flows.sink: classification used by is_user_turn_boundary and rollback trimming

data_flows.transform: parse_visible_hook_prompt_message: collect parsed hook fragments, skip standard contextual text, fail when any other text present

terms.object: TokenUsageInfo (cumulative + last-API-response token usage tracker stored in ContextManager)

data_flows.transform: TokenUsageInfo::new_or_append(prev, next, model_context_window)
info.fill_to_context_window(context_window) OR TokenUsageInfo::full_context_window(context_window)
data_flows.sink: ContextManager.token_info (marks all tokens consumed — used when ContextWindowExceeded with history of 1 item)

terms.object: HistoryEntry (persisted global message-history record for one user message)
attributes: session_id: string (field named conversation_id in original schema but the field value now stores thread id; name preserved for backwards compatibility)
ts: u64 (seconds since Unix epoch at append time)

data_flows.transform: serialize HistoryEntry to JSON + newline, open ~/.codex/history.jsonl with O_APPEND, try_lock with retry, seek to end, write_all, flush, enforce_history_limit
verify file inode/creation_time matches log_id, try_lock_shared with retry, read lines and parse JSON at given offset

history.max_bytes.note: hard cap on history file bytes; when exceeded, trim to HISTORY_SOFT_CAP_RATIO * max_bytes

terms.object: Message History File (global append-only JSONL at ~/.codex/history.jsonl)
attributes: format: JSONL (one HistoryEntry per line, terminated by \n)
log_id: u64 (inode on Unix, creation_time on Windows; used to detect file recreation between write and read)

HistoryPersistence: SaveAll (append every user text entry to history)
None (silently skip all append_entry calls — no history persistence)

data_flows.transform: File::try_lock advisory exclusive lock with up to MAX_RETRIES retries, seek to end, single write(2) of full prepared line, flush, then enforce_history_limit
enforce_history_limit: read all line lengths, compute trim_target = max(soft_cap, newest_entry_len), drop leading lines until size ≤ trim_target, rewrite tail to offset 0, set_len(0), flush

HISTORY_SOFT_CAP_RATIO.note: when history exceeds hard cap, trim it down to this fraction of max_bytes to avoid trimming again immediately on next write

MAX_RETRIES.note: retry count for try_lock/try_lock_shared before giving up

unix_file_mode.source: hardcoded in OpenOptions (unix cfg) and ensure_owner_only_permissions
unix_file_mode.note: owner-only read/write permissions enforced on history file

terms.object: CompactRequestLogData (diagnostic payload captured when remote compaction request fails)
attributes: failing_compaction_request_model_visible_bytes: i64 (sum of estimate_response_item_model_visible_bytes across prompt.input, plus length of base_instructions text)

data_flows.transform: build_compact_request_log_data: fold bytes per item + text length
data_flows.sink: tracing::error! log with turn_id, last_api_response_total_tokens, all_history_items_model_visible_bytes, estimated_tokens_added_since_last_response, estimated_bytes_added_since_last_response, model_context_window_tokens, failing_compaction_request_model_visible_bytes, compact_error

terms.object: Settings Update Bundle (per-turn model-visible delta of turn context settings)
attributes: developer_message: Option<ResponseItem> (role=developer; concatenates model-switch / permissions / collaboration-mode / realtime / personality update sections — in this fixed order)
contextual_user_message: Option<ResponseItem> (role=user; environment-context diff wrapped in <environment_context> tags)
items: Vec<ResponseItem> (at most 2 items, developer message first then contextual user message)

developer_update_sections_order: model_instructions_update (first, so model-specific guidance is read before any other context diffs)
permissions_update (DeveloperInstructions::from_policy when sandbox_policy or approval_policy changed)
realtime_update (realtime_start_message / realtime_end_message based on active transitions)
personality_update (DeveloperInstructions::personality_spec_message when personality changed and model_info.slug unchanged)

data_flows.source: (previous TurnContextItem, previous_turn_settings, next TurnContext, shell, exec_policy, personality_feature_enabled)
data_flows.transform: build_settings_update_items: flatten 5 update sections into developer message + build_environment_update_item for contextual user message

include_permissions_instructions.note: gates whether build_permissions_update_item emits developer text

experimental_realtime_start_instructions.note: when Some, used as custom realtime-start instructions via realtime_start_message_with_instructions

personality_feature_enabled.note: when false, build_personality_update_item returns None unconditionally
